candidate_store_kat.material_instance_rule: Origin is excluded from material identity. Assign immutable material_received_sequence when bytes first become resident; same bytes from a new origin do not refresh it; refetch after byte eviction creates a new resident instance and sequence.
candidate_store_kat.origin_attribution_rule: origin_ref is retrieval-only and never selects quota identity. Exact duplicate is a no-op. Keep at most 4 rows per candidate, 64 per exact scope/group/epoch/origin_domain/origin_quota_domain and 256 total per epoch. Expiry is computed as immutable first_observed_at+2592000 seconds and is not stored; overflow fails closed. Prune expired first, then retain the minimum (first_observed_at,candidate_digest,origin_domain,JCS(origin_quota_domain),JCS(origin_ref)) tuples. Origin attribution never duplicates bytes or changes material_received_sequence.
candidate_store_kat.event_attribution_rule: A success or failure EventCandidateBinding contains no origin and origin cannot be inferred from it. It stores exact Event attribution, candidate_digest, outcome and bounded timestamps only; it never pins candidate secret bytes.

tier_order: received material with no success binding, including unbound and failure-only
deterministic_eviction.effect: Success/failure bindings choose only the tier and never pin bytes. Delete candidate secret bytes and the resident sequence only; retain bounded origin/Event-binding tombstones so refetch can restore material with a new sequence. local_authoritative is never a victim and does not count against received slots.

event_candidate_binding_ledger.expiry_rule: expiry is computed as immutable first_observed_at plus 2592000 seconds, is not stored, and timestamp overflow fails closed
event_candidate_binding_ledger.independence: Pruning attribution metadata never mutates the ciphertext replay ledger, local_authoritative material, or epoch authority.
